rule: A note gives who the character is. Things that a character holds or carries change from page to page and are not part of the character.

cast.name: nan
cast.note: Nan: black-brown hair in exactly two round buns with smooth red ring bands (no bun on top), large dark-brown eyes, an orange T-shirt with a white star, red shorts, white sneakers
cast.pictureNote: The girl is the cast character. The puppy next to her is Pip.

cast.name: pip
cast.note: Pip: a small puppy with golden-brown fur, a cream chest, a cream muzzle, a cream stripe on the forehead, floppy ears with darker tips, large dark-brown eyes, a black nose, a fluffy tail, a red collar with a small round gold tag
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: ben
cast.note: Ben: a five-year-old boy with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), short messy light-brown hair with a fringe, big brown eyes, a big open-mouth happy smile, a light-blue T-shirt, dark-blue shorts, grey sneakers
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: tom
cast.note: Tom: a boy of eight with the same chibi proportions as a five-year-old child (a huge round head, about half of his height, no neck, a short chubby body), only a little taller, with short dark-brown hair swept to the side, big brown eyes, a plain navy-blue T-shirt (no stripes), khaki shorts, red shoes
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same boy.

cast.name: may
cast.note: May: a five-year-old girl with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), black hair with a fringe and one long ponytail at the side with a small yellow star hair clip, big brown eyes, a small smile, a yellow T-shirt, a blue pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: sam
cast.note: Sam: a five-year-old boy with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), short brown hair with a side-swept fringe, big brown eyes, a big open-mouth smile, a red T-shirt with two white stripes across the chest, blue shorts, blue shoes
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: pat
cast.note: Pat: a five-year-old boy with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), short messy black hair with a fringe and a few small tufts on top, big brown eyes, a green T-shirt, brown cargo shorts, brown sandals
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: mia
cast.note: Mia: a five-year-old girl with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), light-brown shoulder-length hair with a small pink bow on the side, big brown eyes, a pink T-shirt, blue denim overalls, white shoes
cast.pictureNote: The 3D figures are the cast. The small flat drawing at the top is an old mockup; ignore it.

cast.name: pam-doll
cast.note: Pam: a small rag doll with short bright yellow yarn hair (a fringe and two short yarn bunches), a round cream cloth face with two round black button eyes, a small stitched smile, and a simple red dress with short sleeves
cast.pictureNote: Three views of the same doll.

cast.name: teacher-kim
cast.note: Teacher Kim: a grown woman, about one and a half times as tall as the children, with medium-length dark-brown hair in a low ponytail, a soft green cardigan over a cream blouse, navy trousers, brown flat shoes, a gentle smile
cast.pictureNote: Group picture, left to right: Ben, Nan, Teacher Kim, Pip.

cast.name: nurse
cast.note: School nurse: a woman of about thirty with short black hair, a small white nurse cap, a white short-sleeved tunic, white trousers, white shoes, a gentle smile
cast.pictureNote: Four views of the same woman.

cast.name: mom
cast.note: Mom: a woman of about thirty-five with wavy shoulder-length dark-brown hair with a side parting, a coral-pink long-sleeved blouse with a collar, blue jeans, white sneakers
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same woman.

cast.name: dad
cast.note: Dad: a man of about thirty-eight with short dark-brown hair with a side parting, a mustard-yellow polo shirt, dark-blue jeans, brown shoes
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same man.

cast.name: lily
cast.note: Lily: a girl of five with a short dark-brown bob with a straight fringe and one small lilac bow at the side of her hair, big brown eyes, a lilac dress with short sleeves and a small white collar, white socks, pink shoes
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same girl.

cast.name: grandma
cast.note: Grandma: an older woman, a little shorter than Mom, with short curly silver-gray hair, a rose-red cardigan over a cream blouse, a long dark-blue skirt, brown flat shoes
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same woman.

cast.name: grandpa
cast.note: Grandpa: an older man, a little shorter than Dad, with short white hair and a small white mustache, a green knitted cardigan over a white shirt, brown trousers, brown shoes
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same man.

cast.name: nans-dad
cast.note: Nan's dad: a man of about thirty-five with short straight black hair, a blue T-shirt, gray shorts, black sandals
cast.pictureNote: Two views of the same man.
